scenarios.name: cmstp_inf_execution
scenarios.description: Real capture: cmstp.exe /s installs a crafted .inf from C:\ProgramData; the CMSTP COM interface then starts cmd.exe through dllhost.exe, which runs whoami.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WORKSTATION5: process cmstp.exe. Review this process and its related activity.
scenarios.label_note: Accepted: the .inf is a UAC bypass (T1548.002) downloaded by the parent PowerShell (T1105, T1059.001); it starts cmd.exe (T1059.003), which runs whoami (T1033).
